title: Functoriality of the torsor description of H^1
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and use, for abelian sheaves on the small Zariski site $X_{\mathrm{Zar}}$ [def-sc-zariski-site], the canonical bijection $H^1(X_{\mathrm{Zar}},G)\cong\{\text{isomorphism classes of }G\text{-torsors}\}$ of [lem-sc-torsor-h1] (Zariski case; torsors as in [def-sc-gm-torsor], cohomology as in [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology]). (1) For a morphism $\varphi:G\to G'$ of abelian sheaves on $X_{\mathrm{Zar}}$, the induced map $H^1(X_{\mathrm{Zar}},G)\to H^1(X_{\mathrm{Zar}},G')$ sends the class of a $G$-torsor $T$ to the class of the $G'$-torsor $T\wedge^{G}G'$, the sheafification of $(T\times G')/G$ with $g\cdot(t,g')=(g\cdot t,\varphi(g)^{-1}g')$ and $G'$ acting on the second factor. (2) For a closed immersion $i:Z\to X$ of schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion] and an abelian sheaf $F$ on $Z_{\mathrm{Zar}}$, the natural isomorphism $H^1(Z_{\mathrm{Zar}},F)\cong H^1(X_{\mathrm{Zar}},i_*F)$ of [lem-sc-cohomology-closed-immersion-pushforward] sends the class of an $F$-torsor $T$ to the class of the $i_*F$-torsor $i_*T$.

source.place: Cohomology, Lemma 02FQ (cohomology-lemma-torsors-h1) and its proof (the class of a torsor as the boundary of 1 in the pushout extension), with Lemma 02UV (cohomology-lemma-cohomology-and-closed-immersions); naturality implicit in Varieties Lemma 09NY proof
